name: Terror Wing Path
summary: Terror Wing Path is a rocky canyon winding through the eastern reaches of the Burning Steppes. Infested by whelps and dragonkin of the black dragonflight, it serves as a perilous approach into the remote northeastern corner of the Steppes.

sections.title: A Dragonkin Roost
sections.body: Carved into the craggy, ash-covered foothills of the eastern Burning Steppes, Terror Wing Path earns its name from the aerial predators and wyrmkin that claim it. Broods of the black dragonflight prowl these defiles, fiercely guarding clutches and hunting anything foolish enough to wander into their shadow. Ash and soot blanket the stone trails, making any trek beneath the canyon walls a treacherous venture.

sections.title: A Perilous Passage
sections.body: Black drakes patrol the length of the valley, and the rare magma giant Volchan is sometimes seen wandering through it. Only the most seasoned adventurers dare the journey, and seldom alone, yet it is the only way to reach the hidden cave of Slither Rock in the far northeastern corner of the Steppes.

faq.q: What creatures live in Terror Wing Path?
faq.answer: The path is infested by whelps, broodlings, and larger dragonkin of the black dragonflight. They patrol the slopes aggressively and hunt ground prey across the eastern pass.

faq.q: Where does Terror Wing Path lead?
faq.answer: It winds through the eastern side of the Burning Steppes into the region's remote northeastern corner, where the cave of Slither Rock lies hidden beyond it.

faq.q: Why is the black dragonflight active in this canyon?
faq.answer: The black dragonflight maintains a strong grip over the Burning Steppes under Blackrock Mountain. Terror Wing Path provides nesting grounds, hunting terrain, and an eastern perimeter guarding the mountain's flanks.

angles.text: The steep terrain and flying whelps make Terror Wing Path a proving ground for marksmen tracking draconic beasts among smoke and canyon winds.
